top_concerns: LTC uses labeled validation groups (G_NW/G_NC) to locate heads, more supervision than TextSpan; label-free LTC-S-hat is weaker and not the headline result
Gender evaluation selects the 10 worst occupations from zero-shot bias on the evaluation data, so regression to the mean inflates gains; no accuracy/utility metric and no variance
Unexplained baseline anomalies: Ortho-Cali ViT-H Waterbirds 18.1 WG, and LTC(MA) identical to TextSpan on FairFace for two backbones
Head-selection derivation (Eqs. 7-10) is heuristic with no controlled or causal validation; interpretability claims rest on a few qualitative examples
Narrow scope and tiny CounterAnimal gains (0.4-1.7 pts) that need an ad hoc class-pairing hack; no general-accuracy checks or significance
